LANDING.TITLE: Every statistic of your team, in one place
LANDING.SUBTITLE: Standings, last games, next games and player statistics, built from the data your league publishes. Try it for free, then create a free account to keep your teams within reach.
LANDING.STEP_1: Pick the association, division, league and team.
LANDING.STEP_2: See the team's standings and games right away.
LANDING.STEP_3: Create a free account to follow your teams and get your recaps.
LANDING.PREVIEW_SUBTITLE: You get {{count}} free previews, no account needed. Pick an association, a division, a league and a team to see its statistics — exactly as in the app.
LANDING.NO_DATA: No data is available yet. Create your free account and we will let you know as soon as your league is imported.
LANDING.CATALOG_ERROR: Associations, divisions, leagues or teams could not be loaded.
LANDING.LIMIT_TITLE: Your free previews are used up
LANDING.LIMIT_BODY: You have used your {{count}} free previews. Create a free account to keep browsing your teams' statistics, without limit.
LANDING.PREVIEW_NOTE: Preview without an account: opponent team pages and game details are for members.
LANDING.BENEFITS_TITLE: What your free account gives you
LANDING.BENEFIT_ACCOUNT_BODY: Follow your teams and find their statistics, standings and games easily every time you come back. No need to pick them again on each visit.
LANDING.BENEFIT_PRESIDENT_BODY: The president of an association can sign up and receive a weekly recap of every team in their league: results, standings and news, in a single email.
LANDING.BENEFIT_DIRECTOR_BODY: A category director receives a weekly recap of every team in their category, to follow their group's progress without browsing team by team.
